trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"openthread/tests/fuzz/cli_uart_received.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":52,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(buf, data, size); otPlatUartReceived(buf, (uint16_t)size);","note":"The fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into a heap buffer and injected as UART input to the CLI stack."},
  {"step":2,"file":"openthread/src/cli/cli_uart.cpp","function":"Uart::ProcessCommand","line":215,"var":"mRxBuffer","code":"if (mRxLength > 0) { mInterpreter.ProcessLine(mRxBuffer, mRxLength, *this); }","note":"The received UART line is handed to the CLI interpreter as a mutable command string."},
  {"step":3,"file":"openthread/src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"Interpreter::ProcessLine","line":3749,"var":"cmd/argv","code":"Utils::CmdLineParser::ParseCmd(aBuf, argc, argv, kMaxArgs);","note":"The attacker-controlled line is tokenized into argv entries, preserving the service command and its arguments."},
  {"step":4,"file":"openthread/src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"Interpreter::ProcessLine","line":3766,"var":"sCommands[i].mCommand","code":"if (strcmp(cmd, sCommands[i].mName) == 0) { (this->*sCommands[i].mCommand)(argc - 1, &argv[1]); }","note":"The parsed command name 'service' dispatches execution into the service handler."},
  {"step":5,"file":"openthread/src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"Interpreter::ProcessService","line":1622,"var":"argv[2]/argv[3]","code":"cfg.mServiceDataLength = static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[2])); memcpy(cfg.mServiceData, argv[2], cfg.mServiceDataLength); cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength = static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[3])); memcpy(cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData, argv[3], cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength);","note":"The attacker-controlled service and server strings are copied into fixed-size stack arrays, with lengths truncated to uint8_t."},
  {"step":6,"file":"openthread/src/core/api/server_api.cpp","function":"otServerAddService","line":57,"var":"aConfig","code":"return instance.GetThreadNetif().GetNetworkDataLocal().AddService(... aConfig->mServiceDataLength, ... aConfig->mServerConfig.mServerDataLength);","note":"The stack-built service configuration is forwarded into network-data construction without revalidating the copied lengths."},
  {"step":7,"file":"openthread/src/core/thread/network_data_local.cpp","function":"Local::AddService","line":166,"var":"serviceTlvLength","code":"uint8_t serviceTlvLength = ... + aServiceDataLength + ... + aServerDataLength + sizeof(ServerTlv);","note":"The TLV size is accumulated in an 8-bit variable, so oversized attacker-controlled lengths can wrap and understate the required insertion size."},
  {"step":8,"file":"openthread/src/core/thread/network_data_local.cpp","function":"Local::AddService","line":173,"var":"serviceTlv","code":"serviceTlv = reinterpret_cast<ServiceTlv *>(mTlvs + mLength); Insert(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(serviceTlv), serviceTlvLength + sizeof(NetworkDataTlv));","note":"The wrapped length is used to reserve too little space before writing the service TLV contents."},
  {"step":9,"file":"openthread/src/core/thread/network_data_local.cpp","function":"Local::AddService","line":176,"var":"serviceTlv->SetServiceData","code":"serviceTlv->SetServiceData(aServiceData, aServiceDataLength);","note":"The full attacker-controlled service data is copied into the under-sized TLV buffer, causing the stack-buffer-overflow write observed by ASAN."}
]
with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(trace,f,separators=(',',':'))
print('wrote trace')
